page_title: INT 3-1 EMP | Inter v Empoli 19/01/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+4' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.

90+4' A neat pass is well received by Marcus Thuram (Inter), who is lurking on the edge of the box and strikes the ball towards the middle of the target. The goalkeeper makes a decent save to block his shot.

90+2' A precise cross towards the penalty spot was latched onto by Carlos Augusto (Inter). He outjumped the defence and produced a decent header which went a whisker wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Empoli will have a goal kick.
90' We will have 4 min. of added time.

89' 3 - 1 GOAL! Superb work from Marko Arnautovic, who plays a vital role in the build-up. He squares it to Marcus Thuram (Inter), who beats Devis Stiven Vasquez Llach with a brilliant shot into the bottom left corner. 3:1.
85' Substitution. Matteo Darmian (Inter) in, Benjamin Pavard out.
83' Roberto D'Aversa prepares a substitution. Liberato Cacace is replaced by Szymon Zurkowski (Empoli).
83' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Giuseppe Pezzella walks off the pitch to be replaced by Junior Sambia (Empoli).
83' 2 - 1 Goal! Liam Henderson slips a clever pass through to Sebastiano Esposito (Empoli), who moves inside the box and sends a measured shot beyond the keeper and into the bottom left corner. 2:1.
81' The resulting set piece from Inter is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
79' 2 - 0 The resulting corner is whipped in by Kristjan Asllani and Denzel Dumfries (Inter) is left unmarked to plant a precise header into the top left corner. The score is 2:0.
78' The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Inter.
78' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Marko Arnautovic (Inter) is coming onto the pitch as Lautaro Martinez cannot continue after picking up an injury.
77' The manager makes a subsitution with Alessandro Bastoni (Inter) coming on for Federico Dimarco.

76' Denzel Dumfries (Inter) swept past a couple of defenders inside the box and tried to score low in the middle of the goal, but great anticipation by Devis Stiven Vasquez Llach allowed him to make a comfortable save.
73' Here is a change. Alberto Grassi is going off and Roberto D'Aversa gives the last tactical orders to Liam Henderson (Empoli).
72' The up-to-date shots on target statistics – 3:0.
69' Piotr Zielinski will be replaced by Henrikh Mkhitaryan (Inter).
69' We are about to witness a substitution. Marcus Thuram (Inter) is replacing Mehdi Taremi.
66' Roberto D'Aversa has decided to make a change. Saba Goglichidze (Empoli) replaces Mattia De Sciglio.
66' Substitution. Jacopo Fazzini is replaced by Sebastiano Esposito (Empoli).
60' Empoli work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.

58' Lautaro Martinez (Inter) produces a ferocious strike from the edge of the box. His dangerous effort towards the roof of the net is blocked by Devis Stiven Vasquez Llach, who pulls off a superb save to keep the ball out of the net.
58' Inter seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. Great movement by the offensive players allows the defenders to set up the attack.
55' 1 - 0 Goal - 1:0! Lautaro Martinez (Inter) gets a shot away from the edge of the box and scores into the top right corner. Nicolo Barella provided an assist for the goal.
53' We can have a look at the statistics now, particularly the total attempts – 9:3.

50' Giuseppe Pezzella (Empoli) collects a sweet pass on the edge of the box and in one movement smashes a shot in on goal, but it balloons high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Inter.
50' Empoli take a short corner kick.
49' Kristjan Asllani (Inter) sends in the corner, but the keeper steps in and makes a save.
49' Denzel Dumfries (Inter) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked. Inter earn a corner.
48' Inter are playing possession football and controlling the game at present. They are exchanging inch-perfect passes from player to player, making it difficult for the opposition to win the ball.
46' The whistle blows and Ermano Feliciani starts the second half.
45+3' The match has reached half-time.
45+1' Inter take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
45' The fourth official shows 2 min. of added time.
44' PENALTY APPEAL after Kristjan Asllani (Inter) goes down under a challenge from the defender. All players chase the referee but he's not interested in the penalty claim. Play continues.
42' The ball possession is 70:30.
39' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Inter, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
37' Kristjan Asllani (Inter) floats the ball in from the corner but it's intercepted.
36' Mehdi Taremi (Inter) is able to continue to play.
35' Looks like Mehdi Taremi (Inter) is struggling after picking up a knock. Hopefully he can run it off.
32' Nicolo Barella (Inter) pounced on a rebound on the edge of the box and his shot goes a whisker over the crossbar. The ball goes out of play and Empoli will have a goal kick.
31' Federico Dimarco (Inter) swings in the corner kick, but one of the defenders leaps highest to head the ball away.

30' What a miss! Lautaro Martinez (Inter) is left standing right in front of goal with only the keeper to beat after a clever pass, but he somehow contrives to toe poke the ball just past the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Empoli.
27' The foul by Mehdi Taremi (Inter) was seen by Ermano Feliciani who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.

26' Lautaro Martinez (Inter) gathers a cross inside the box and strikes the ball. He wastes a great scoring opportunity as his shot only hits the right-hand post. The ball goes out of play and Empoli will have a goal kick.
23' Federico Dimarco (Inter) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence.
21' Inter are showing great team chemistry. They are passing it around beautifully. Excellent team work.
18' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Empoli, is overhit and the ball goes out of play. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Inter.
15' Denzel Dumfries (Inter) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat.
14' Nicolo Barella (Inter) gets to the rebound just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by one of the defending players.
11' Lautaro Martinez (Inter) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.
10' Inter failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
9' Lautaro Martinez (Inter) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
8' Denzel Dumfries (Inter) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player. It will be a corner kick for Inter.
7' The Inter players are displaying brilliant short passes and great ball movement. They are waiting to open the opposition's defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
5' Piotr Zielinski (Inter) reacts well to get to the rebound and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but he fails to get the ball through the players standing between him and the goal.
4' Mattia Viti (Empoli) shoots from the edge of the penalty area. The ball travels towards the bottom left corner, but Yann Sommer easily deals with the threat.
2' Kristjan Asllani (Inter) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Ermano Feliciani no option but to blow his whistle.
1' The first half has started.
The players are out at last! Inter will take the kick-off.
The referee of today's match will be Ermano Feliciani.
